units.title: Invert the lead's biggest fear

claim.text: The source advises identifying what leads are most afraid of and then immediately doing the opposite of that fear.
claim.quote: what are they most scared of? And then how can you immediately do the opposite of that thing?

args.text: Leads remain scared after becoming a lead, fearing a pitch or a wrong decision.

units.title: Script every lead phone call
